signals.title: Un enlace compartido de ChatGPT podría ejecutar código de atacante en tu sesión y leer chats privados
signals.summary: Un enlace malicioso de ChatGPT puede ejecutar código del atacante en la sesión iniciada del usuario y leer sus conversaciones; la falla se informó y OpenAI la corrigió en ocho días.
signals.title_orig: A Shared ChatGPT Link Could Run Attacker Code in Your Session and Read Private Chats
signals.summary_orig: A malicious ChatGPT share link could run an attacker's code in the logged-in session of anyone who opened it, allowing them to read their private conversations, researchers at the security firm Parameter showed. The researchers reported the flaw through OpenAI's bug bounty program on October 18, and OpenAI fixed it eight days later and rated it P1, its most serious category.

signals.title: Agentes de seguridad de IA comparados: Claude, Codex, Mantis, Cloudflare
signals.summary: Anthropic, OpenAI, Cloudflare y Google lanzaron agentes de IA que detectan y corrigen vulnerabilidades en código, siguiendo el mismo ciclo de encontrar, refutar y parchear.
signals.title_orig: AI Security Agents Compared: Claude, Codex, Mantis, Cloudflare
signals.summary_orig: Anthropic, OpenAI, Cloudflare and Google each released an AI agent that hunts security bugs in source code. All 4 use the same find, disprove, then patch loop. Here is how they differ, plus 12 more tools. The post AI Security Agents Compared: Claude, Codex, Mantis, Cloudflare appeared first on MarkTechPost .

signals.title: Extensión de código Claude malicioso en puertas traseras SSH plantadas con cursor
signals.summary: Una versión maliciosa de la extensión Claude Code de Anthropic se distribuyó en el marketplace de Cursor durante 11 horas el 29 de octubre, infectando a hasta 5 000 desarrolladores con malware que instala backdoors SSH persistentes.
signals.title_orig: Malicious Claude Code extension on Cursor planted SSH backdoors
signals.summary_orig: A malicious version of Anthropic's Claude Code VS Code extension was distributed through Cursor's extension marketplace for approximately 11 hours on October 29, exposing up to 5,000 developers to malware designed to install persistent SSH backdoors. [...]

signals.title: Samaya AI lanza Sterling: un modelo de agente de investigación financiera 3B-Active que supera a Claude Fable 5.1 en FrontierFinance a un costo 11 veces menor
signals.summary: Sterling de Samaya AI, modelo Nemotron 3.5 Lightning entrenado para finanzas, alcanza 58,9 % en FrontierFinance a $0,61 por consulta, superando a Claude Fable 5.1 (55,9 % a $6,89).
signals.title_orig: Samaya AI Releases Sterling: A 3B-Active Finance Research Agent Model that Beats Claude Fable 5.1 on FrontierFinance at 11x Lower Cost
signals.summary_orig: Samaya AI’s Sterling is a post-trained Nemotron 3.5 Lightning model for financial research. It scores 58.9% on FrontierFinance at $0.61 per question, beating Claude Fable 5.1’s 55.9% at $6.89. The post Samaya AI Releases Sterling: A 3B-Active Finance Research Agent Model that Beats Claude Fable 5.1 on FrontierFinance at 11x Lower Cost appeared first on MarkTechPost .
